name: PixelGrid2D Construction
definition: A 2D grid containing voxel information, implemented as a `Grid2D<BitArray, bool>`, initialized from a bounding box, voxel dimensions, and a BitArray.
summary: PixelGrid2D Construction builds a 2D grid from a bounding box and pre-computed bit array, differing from dynamic methods by using a static set of active voxels.
